query:
UPDATE drifted_handle
           SET healed_at = NOW(),
               claimed_by = NULL,
               claim_expires_at = NULL,
               next_retry_at = NULL
         WHERE consensus_epoch = $1
           AND coprocessor_context_id = $2
           AND host_chain_id = $3
           AND handle = $4
           AND healed_at IS NULL
           AND can_be_healed
           AND quorum_ct64_digest = $5
